blocks.text: Explains the four modules in the package (profile, bwrap, probe, __init__) and the three questions this file answers: is a sandbox available, is it available as a bool, and run a fresh probe. States the invariant that the sandbox is never assumed, and that callers that get 'not available' must say 'full privileges' and mean it.
blocks.title: Module docstring

blocks.text: Frozen dataclass with four fields: available (bool), reason_code (a fixed word like 'ok' or 'bwrap_missing'), reason (human text, never a path or a command), and probe (the full ProbeResult or None). Its docstring spells out that only 'ok' means truly available.
blocks.title: SandboxStatus dataclass

blocks.text: default_denied imports config_dir lazily (to avoid circular imports) and returns the m2c config directory as a tuple of one string; on any exception it returns (). get_status calls default_denied when denied is None, then delegates to session_probe and wraps the result.
blocks.title: default_denied and get_status

blocks.text: Takes the same keyword arguments as get_status but calls run_probe directly, skipping the session cache. Returns ProbeResult rather than SandboxStatus so the doctor can inspect individual check outcomes.
blocks.title: fresh_probe for the doctor

gotchas: available is True ONLY when every probe check passed — partial passes still yield available=False
reset() clears the session cache and exists for tests only; production code should not call it
default_denied silently swallows all exceptions to avoid crashing if config_dir is unavailable at that moment
how_it_works: SandboxStatus is a frozen dataclass wrapping the boolean result plus a reason_code and a ProbeResult
get_status delegates to session_probe (cached per settings tuple in probe.py), then wraps the ProbeResult in a SandboxStatus via _status

default_denied imports config_dir from m2c.paths at call time and returns the config directory as the one path that sandbox mounts must never expose; silently returns () if the config dir cannot be determined
fresh_probe calls run_probe directly, bypassing the session cache
inputs: extra_ro (additional read-only paths for the profile)
toolchain_dirs (directories to expose for language runtimes)
denied (override for the denied-path list; None → default_denied())
purpose: Gives the rest of m2c a single import point for sandbox availability. It never assumes the sandbox works; every call path that returns a 'not available' status carries a machine-readable reason_code and a human-readable reason so callers can explain the situation accurately. The cache (session_probe) is per-process; fresh_probe bypasses it for the doctor command.
side_effects: First call to get_status (or is_available) with new settings spawns a bubblewrap probe subprocess (inside probe.py)
summary: Public API of the m2c.sandbox package: status queries, the denied-path default, and a fresh-probe entry point for the diagnostic doctor.
